## Description {#details}

This class provides a lightweight, constexpr-compatible alternative to <code>std::source&#95;location</code> for environments lacking C++20 standard support.

It enables retrieval of the file name and line number at the point of invocation, supporting enhanced diagnostics and reporting within the µTest++ framework.

The static <code><Link to="#a6e2ad380f42d7a7ec3c92268a5976e58">current()</Link></code> method captures the current source location, using compiler built-ins where available, or defaulting to <code>&quot;unknown&quot;</code> and zero otherwise.


<SectionUser title="Since">
3.0.0
</SectionUser>

### current() {#a6e2ad380f42d7a7ec3c92268a5976e58}

<MemberDefinition
  prototype={<>static constexpr auto micro&#95;os&#95;plus::micro&#95;test&#95;plus::reflection::source&#95;location::current (const char &#42; file=&quot;unknown&quot;, unsigned int line=&#123;&#125;)</>}
  labels = {["inline", "nodiscard", "constexpr", "noexcept", "static"]}>
Obtain the current source location.

---

Returns a <code><Link to="/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/reflection/source-location">source&#95;location</Link></code> instance representing the file name and line number at the point of invocation.

If supported by the compiler, uses built-in macros to capture this information; otherwise, defaults to <code>&quot;unknown&quot;</code> and zero.


<ParametersList title="Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="file">The file name (automatically provided by the compiler).</ParametersListItem>
<ParametersListItem name="line">The line number (automatically provided by the compiler).</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>

<SectionUser title="Returns">
